items.meaning: 聯想；把某物和另一物連在一起

examples.en: Purple __reminds me of__ the sky.
What does it __remind you of__?
My **childhood** bedroom had Tinker Bell __bed sheets__.
Now, I wear a lot of __light-colored__ clothes, light colors like white, yellow, orange, and light green.
I think my __skin tone__ 《suits》 lighter colors.
That's why I __feel my best__ when I'm wearing light clothing.
Whenever I see someone wearing red clothing, I __think to myself__, 'Wow, she or he is very **confident**,' because I think the color red is a very **confident** color.
It makes any person who wears it __stand out__.
They __stand out__ in a **crowd**, and they just seem interesting.
Something that __draws the eye in__?

examples.en: Those two colors __work together__ so well.
What are two colors you think __work together__ very, very well?

phrases.meaning: 把兩個事物在心中連結起來

examples.en: I have always __associated the color green with__ trees, grass, and beautiful **landscapes**.
examples.tc: 把兩個事物在心中連結起來

examples.en: Do you __associate the color green with__ anything?
examples.tc: 把兩個事物在心中連結起來

Could you live in a country that was very 《gray》 __all the time__?

examples.en: Practice saying your answers __out loud__ and writing them for me to see your **improvement**.
examples.tc: 發出聲音地說，而不是只在心裡想

usages.usage: 當動詞，表示顏色、衣服或風格適合某人
examples: I think my __skin tone__ 《suits》 lighter colors.

usages.usage: 形容地方或天氣灰濛濛、陰沉、缺少色彩，不只是單純的顏色
examples: I could not live in England because it is too 《gray》.
Could you live in a country that was very 《gray》 __all the time__?

breakdowns.sentence: What does it remind you of?

points.label: 疑問句中的介系詞放句尾
points.text: What + does + 主詞 + 動詞 + 受詞 + of?
points.note: of 是 remind someone of something 的一部分，問句中 what 移到句首，of 留在句尾

breakdowns.sentence: Now, I wear a lot of light-colored clothes, light colors like white, yellow, orange, and light green.
breakdowns.translation: 現在，我穿很多淺色衣服，像白色、黃色、橘色和淺綠色這樣的淺色。

points.label: 同位補充說明
points.text: 名詞片語 + comma + 補充說明的名詞片語
points.note: light colors like... 補充解釋前面的 light-colored clothes 包含哪些顏色

breakdowns.sentence: I think my skin tone suits lighter colors.
breakdowns.translation: 我覺得我的膚色適合比較淺的顏色。

points.label: think 後接省略 that 的名詞子句
points.text: I think + 主詞 + 動詞
points.note: my skin tone suits lighter colors 是 think 的內容，口語中常省略 that

breakdowns.sentence: Every color makes me feel different.
breakdowns.translation: 每一種顏色都讓我有不同的感受。

points.label: 使役動詞 make + 受詞 + 補語
points.note: make 後面接受詞 me，再接 feel different，表示造成某種感受

breakdowns.sentence: That's why I feel my best when I'm wearing light clothing.
breakdowns.translation: 所以我穿淺色衣服時感覺最好。

points.label: That's why... 結果說明句
points.text: That's why + 主詞 + 動詞
points.note: 用來說明前面原因造成的結果，意思是「所以這就是為什麼...」

breakdowns.sentence: Whenever I see someone wearing red clothing, I think to myself, 'Wow, she or he is very confident,' because I think the color red is a very confident color.
breakdowns.translation: 每當我看到有人穿紅色衣服，我會在心裡想：「哇，她或他非常有自信。」因為我覺得紅色是一種很有自信的顏色。

points.label: whenever 時間副詞子句；see + 受詞 + V-ing
points.text: Whenever + 主詞 + 動詞, 主句 / see + someone + V-ing
points.note: whenever 表示「每當」；wearing 補充說明看到某人正在穿的狀態

breakdowns.sentence: I don't know what it is about the color red that is so intense and powerful.
breakdowns.translation: 我不知道紅色到底有什麼地方這麼強烈又有力量。

points.label: 間接問句與強調式結構
points.text: I don't know + what it is about X + that + be + adjective
points.note: 用來表達「不知道 X 到底哪一點如此...」，比直接說 X is intense 更強調困惑感

breakdowns.sentence: It makes any person who wears it stand out.
breakdowns.translation: 它會讓任何穿著紅色的人變得很顯眼。

points.label: 關係子句搭配使役 make
points.text: make + 受詞 + 原形動詞；person + who + 動詞
points.note: who wears it 修飾 person，stand out 用原形是因為前面有使役動詞 make

breakdowns.sentence: What's a color you think stands out?
breakdowns.translation: 你覺得什麼顏色會很顯眼？

points.label: 省略關係代名詞的名詞修飾
points.text: a color + you think + 動詞
points.note: you think stands out 修飾 a color，中間省略了 that，意思是「你認為會突出的顏色」

breakdowns.sentence: I think it would make me feel overwhelmed and stressed.
breakdowns.translation: 我覺得那會讓我感到不知所措又有壓力。

points.label: would 表假設結果
points.note: would 表示想像中的情況，不是在說一定會發生的事

breakdowns.sentence: I have always associated the color green with trees, grass, and beautiful landscapes.
breakdowns.translation: 我一直把綠色和樹、草，以及美麗的風景聯想在一起。

points.label: 現在完成式搭配 always
points.text: have / has + always + 過去分詞
points.note: 表示從過去到現在一直有這種聯想

breakdowns.sentence: Landscapes like mountains, rainforests, and farms.
breakdowns.translation: 像山、雨林和農場那樣的風景。

points.label: 名詞片語片段
points.note: 口語字幕中用不完整句補充舉例，like 後面列出 landscapes 的例子

breakdowns.sentence: No matter where you turn, you will see green and more green and more green as far as the eye can see.
breakdowns.translation: 不管你轉向哪裡，你都會看到綠色、更多綠色、再更多綠色，一直延伸到視線所及的地方。

points.label: no matter where 讓步副詞子句
points.text: No matter where + 主詞 + 動詞, 主句
points.note: 表示「不論往哪裡」，後面的主句說明結果都一樣

breakdowns.sentence: A place I could never live in is England.
breakdowns.translation: 有一個我永遠無法居住的地方是英格蘭。

points.label: 省略關係代名詞且介系詞留句尾
points.text: A place + 主詞 + could + never + live in + be + 名詞
points.note: I could never live in 修飾 a place，介系詞 in 留在修飾片語最後

breakdowns.sentence: When I was in England, I used to get so sad, and I was so tired all the time.
breakdowns.translation: 當我在英格蘭時，我以前常常變得很難過，而且我總是很累。

points.label: used to 表過去習慣或過去狀態
points.note: 表示以前常常如此，暗示現在情況可能不同

breakdowns.sentence: Could you live in a country that was very gray all the time?
breakdowns.translation: 你能住在一個總是非常灰濛濛的國家嗎？

points.label: could 假設問句與關係子句
points.text: Could + 主詞 + 原形動詞 + 名詞 + that + 動詞
points.note: could 用來問想像中的可能性；that was very gray all the time 修飾 country

breakdowns.sentence: Practice saying your answers out loud and writing them for me to see your improvement.
breakdowns.translation: 練習大聲說出你的答案，也把它們寫下來，讓我看見你的進步。

points.label: practice + V-ing；for someone to + V
points.text: practice + V-ing and V-ing / for + someone + to + verb
points.note: practice 後接動名詞；for me to see 表示「為了讓我看見」
